newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: At least 35 killed at S.African mine - radio.
newsitem.headline: At least 35 killed at S.African mine - radio.

text.p: At least 35 people have been killed in ethnic clashes at and around a South African platinum mine 100 km (60 miles) northwest of Johannesburg, state radio said on Sunday.
It said the violence at Wildebeesfontein mine near Rustenburg broke out on Saturday morning and raged sporadically for about 24 hours before being brought under control.
The radio said the fighting first broke out at a squatter camp near the mine, pitting Sotho-speaking men against members of the Xhosa tribe.
It said police had only reported the violence on Sunday.
The radio quoted a police spokeswoman as saying 12 people were killed at the squatter camp but that the fighting then spread to the mine.
